fix_commit.message: [sfnt] Avoid allocation bomb in compressed SVG documents.
fix_commit.author: Werner Lemberg

findings.title: SVG glyph loading reaches an unbounded gzip expansion allocation
findings.message: The newly added glyph-load call reaches tt_face_load_svg_doc. That parser trusts the gzip trailer's uncompressed size and requests a buffer of that size before imposing a cap.

location.description: New public glyph-load reachability in the exact 2022 introduction.

related_locations.description: Preexisting dormant allocation reached by the new glyph-load call.

findings.suggestion: At the introducing revision, reject gzip SVG documents whose uncomp_size is at least 1<<26 before FT_QALLOC in src/sfnt/ttsvg.c. Preserve a normal error return for such input; the upstream fix adds this exact size cap.

ground_truth.root_cause: tt_face_load_svg_doc reads the gzip trailer's ISIZE as uncomp_size and passes it to FT_QALLOC without a cap. Before this introduction, the public glyph loader did not call the SVG document loader. The 2025 fix bounds ISIZE; an equivalent small guard applies to the 2022 tree.
